publication_bundle.summary: Frozen reports rendered to ranked and stratified tables; all seven 5% gate failures, seven unranked candidates, source hashes, and limitations retained.

limitations: Tables are regenerated from frozen development benchmark reports; no new model inference is performed.
All seven candidates use text-only adapters; WER does not establish valid application timestamps or clinical safety.
The 5% gate remains unchanged and candidate failures are retained.
Clinical adjudication remains pending and no production model is selected.
